title: "your next end step" encoded as the next end step (5 cards)
body:
"Your next end step" is encoded as `AtTheBeginningOfTheNextEndStep`; it should be `AtTheBeginningOfPlayersNextEndStep(You)`.

- Necropotence, Esper Terra, Desert Warfare: on an opponent's turn this happens at that opponent's end step, not yours
- Mardu Siegebreaker; Greasefang, Okiba Boss: same encoding, though only reached on your own turn
